import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        double[] p = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = sc.nextDouble();
        }

        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (p[i] > 0.000001) {
                cnt++;
            }
        }

        if (cnt <= k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (p[i] > 0.000001) {
                    System.out.print("1 ");
                } else {
                    System.out.print("0 ");
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
            return;
        }

        double[] ans = new double[n];
        double[] dp = new double[1 << n];
        for (int i = 0; i < dp.length; i++) {
            dp[i] = 0.0;
        }
        dp[0] = 1.0;

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    sum += p[i];
                }
            }
            if (sum >= 0.99999) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    int nextMask = mask | (1 << i);
                    dp[nextMask] += dp[mask] * p[i] / (1 - sum);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            if (count != k) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    ans[i] += dp[mask];
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.out.printf("%.13f ", ans[i]);
        }
        System.out.println();
    }
}
